chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the man who performs Tawaf around the House but cuts it short, he said: He should fulfil what he shortens from his Tawaf.

key_terms.طَوَاف: Tawaf, the ritual circumambulation of the Kaaba

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone stops their Tawaf early?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that if one interrupts Tawaf before reaching the Black Stone (Hajar al-Aswad), the obligation is not voided but requires making up the missed rounds, emphasizing the continuity of the ritual. This ruling highlights the Shia jurisprudential view that Tawaf is a continuous act where partial completion counts, provided the break was not due to a major invalidator. It serves as a practical guide for pilgrims experiencing fatigue or distraction during the circumambulation.
